review.verdict: No deaths, Sartura 96 and Ouro 95, and Huhuran where you spent eight seconds silenced
review.summary: A 77 average against your usual 80 and, for once, no deaths at all. Sartura 96, Ouro 95 and Skeram 90 were the highlights. The two big drops have reasons in the log: on Fankriss you were blowing up bugs with Arcane Explosion, and on Huhuran Noxious Poison silenced you for eight seconds of a 41 second kill.

good.title: Sartura 96, Ouro 95, Skeram 90
good.text: Skeram 90 is well over your usual 64 there; Sartura and Ouro are at your best.

good.title: Fankriss bugs
good.text: 9 Arcane Explosions on the adds: fourth in the raid counting all targets, which is why the parse (boss damage only) dropped to 65.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Supreme Power, Zanza, Greater Arcane, Firepower and Mageblood on all 9 boss pulls: 5.9 a pull against 4.7 for the other DPS.

fix.title: Huhuran
fix.text: 47 against your usual 92. Noxious Poison silenced you from 0:14 to 0:22 of a 41 second kill, which is most of it. It spreads to people nearby, so give yourself a few yards.

fix.title: Twin Emperors' bug
fix.text: An exploding bug hit you for 3,103, the most of the three people it caught.

fix.title: Royalty
fix.text: 76, under your usual 77 with two fears from Yauj and 14 Toxic Volley hits.

50712.text: On bug duty with Arcane Explosion.

review.verdict: Three personal bests, no deaths, and the consumables of someone raiding AQ40 out of a starter bag
review.summary: A 72 average against your usual 55, personal bests on Royalty, Sartura and Huhuran, fourth highest damage on the Twin Emperors, and you didn't die. Which makes it worse: you did all that on 3 consumable buffs a boss pull against 4.7 for the other DPS. No flask, no Zanza, no Juju, food on 3 of 9 pulls. You're not underperforming, you're under-eating.

good.title: Viscidus
good.text: 35 Hamstrings: cheap, fast hits while he was frozen.

fix.title: Buy a flask
fix.text: 3 buffs per boss pull against 4.7 for the other DPS: no flask, no Zanza, no Juju, and Well Fed on 3 of 9 pulls. Every other warrior showed up to AQ40 like it was AQ40. You showed up like it was a Tuesday in Westfall.

fix.title: Sartura's Whirlwind
fix.text: Three Whirlwind hits for 4,815, more than most (raid median 3,946). She telegraphs it by spinning. You telegraphed standing still.

fix.title: Skeram
fix.text: 35. That's your usual there, which is the roast.
